VinFast to Launch Three Electric Scooter Models in India Next Year

Vietnamese electric vehicle manufacturer VinFast is set to launch three electric scooter models in India in the coming year. The company, which has already established a presence in the electric car market, confirmed its entry into the Indian electric scooter market with these new models. The scooters are expected to offer a range of up to 165 km.
